artboards.title: Candidate explorer — reads the live daemon

annotations.text:
decentralized.cloud — a public face over the Hypervisor daemon.

Direction A is the leading candidate and is what the identity sheet, the system and both product surfaces are built on. B and C are live alternatives, each with its own case and its own tradeoff.

Every colour and every face is inherited from packages/design-system. The product invents no hue of its own.

The two surfaces are deliberately different kinds of thing.

The explorer reads the running daemon and shows exactly what it returned — including, right now, an honest empty state.

The composer is drawn to the canonical CloudJobRequest shape and submits nothing. It is labelled unwired on the surface itself, not only in a note.
